title: RAW UNREVIEWED: two complete instruction groups with an explicitly repeated plant kind
summary: Root-proposed finite meaningful writer: A=(plant,part,state,amount), B=(plant,operation,medium,duration). Both use exactly the same injective four-tuple spelling; role comes only from paragraph-anchored alternation. The repeated plant kind agrees within each adjacent pair. All seven original GDT1174 fields remain recoverable. No native meanings, new source, dictionary of whole messages or claimed statistical fit.

design.mechanism: Write each old1174 record (op,plant,part,state,medium,amount,duration) as exactly two groups A=(plant,part,state,amount), B=(plant,op,medium,duration), in that order. Repeat the plant-kind value explicitly. No field is inferred from source topic, picture or prior record.
design.unit: One group encodes (plant,x,y,z) in domains64,8,8,4. The same tuple has the same spelling in either position, without separate A/B role prefixes. A paragraph starts in A phase and must end after B. Physical line wraps do not reset phase.
design.contrast: 1174 systems2/3 write five separate roles and system4 writes seven. This proposal writes two compound groups and repeats plant kind, redistributing the small fields into both groups. It is not a new glyph key for their unchanged word streams.
design.prediction: After decoding each adjacent A/B pair, its two plant-kind fields must agree. A mismatch or an incomplete pair rejects that complete-message binding. Exact neighboring repeated groups are legal whenever their four numeric values coincide; there is no compulsory shared initial for all repeats and no two-terminal restriction. No native pair alignment or identity component is thereby established.
design.scope: Complete only for the unchanged finite1174 message universe. Unknown plants, new predicates, conditions, negation, free references and arbitrary natural-language sentences have no representation and must be rejected, never silently paraphrased. A new full-language claim would require another explicit grammar, not an unpaid fallback.
design.source_inventory: Use exactly the existing ordered PLANTS, PARTS, STATES, OPS, MEDIA, AMOUNTS and TIMES lists in experiments/yolo/gdt1174_ten_scribes_forward_comparison/src/scribes.py. Their sizes are64,8,8,8,8,4,4. No source generator, weights, plant classes or record ordering may be changed for a capacity check.
design.encode: For each record write A then B. Every record refers to a new portion, as in1174. The plant field is a kind, not a unique physical-object identifier. B applies to the portion introduced by immediately preceding A because of the pair grammar; plant agreement checks kind consistency but cannot distinguish two otherwise identical portions.
design.decode: From the visible paragraph start read groups in pairs. Invert the common tuple spelling for A and B. Require A.plant=B.plant and all field ranges legal. Recover record (B.x,A.plant,A.x,A.y,B.y,A.z,B.z). Preserve record and paragraph order. Reject odd group counts and mismatched plant fields. Only one pending A and one phase bit are needed, both explicitly taught.

teaching_carrier_only.purpose: A complete by-hand existence demonstration, NOT a proposed native carrier or an alphabet to optimize. The intended necessary frequency comparison concerns the common injective tuple spelling only.
teaching_carrier_only.write: For (plant,x,y,z), write the five digit signs for floor(plant/8), plant mod8, x, y, z. Keep leading zero digits. Every group has exactly five working signs. The final digit is restricted to0..3.
teaching_carrier_only.read: Read five working signs as digits h,j,x,y,z. Require z<4. Recover plant=8*h+j, then the common tuple. Sign names such as ch denote one stipulated teaching item, not two Latin characters.
teaching_carrier_only.known_failure_and_limit: This teaching carrier already conflicts with the varied working-sign group lengths of retained f45r.10 under that literal atom/group binding. It is not a surviving Voynich realization. It uses only eight of the available22 signs and makes no coverage claim. Its endings include y/r/l, and different plant ranges allow repeated identical pairs with different first signs. Those facts do not repair its length contradiction. The abstract two-group organization is separated from this failed-as-native illustration before any capacity result.

design.learning_cost: 104 ordered semantic entries:64 plant kinds,32 entries across four8-value lists, and8 across two4-value lists; plus eight digit/sign correspondences, plant quotient/remainder by8, five-slot reading, two-group grammar and explicit agreement. These are learned meanings of an artificial notation, not native assignments. No16384-entry whole-group lexicon or hidden2130-entry fragment table is supplied. The pending A costs one finite tuple; no long reference history.
design.smallest_proposed_falsifier: Root may inspect only the unchanged1174 message sequence under exactly this shared tuple map: first4000 complete records give8000 groups. Because spelling is fixed and injective over common tuples, output equality/type/top-ten counts are invariant under any alternative injective common carrier. Necessary-frequency failure would close this fixed source/group contract before alphabet construction. A positive would establish only capacity not excluded; no native pair, statistics pass, complete historical writing system or translation follows. No grouping sweep or source adjustment is proposed.

That bound concerns one stored CoReMA source token per output group with at most two spellings. Here seven artificial content fields form two compound groups. No claim that1202 tested this contract.
No vertical character columns, retiring rows, END cells or cell-balance invariant. Its exclusion of941 and open-edge relaxation remain.

Agreement and repeated identity are not new topics. Those native semantic/participant hypotheses do not supply this complete finite two-group source writer. No native participant meaning is inherited.
